facts.description: The instructional image is divided into one-time setup and recurring presentation use.
The optional wireless LAN module is installed correctly before wireless setup.
facts.expected_value: Remove the wireless LAN module cover screw, insert the optional module into the projector USB-A port, then reinstall and secure the cover. The guide identifies module part V12H731P02.

facts.description: The projector is powered on with the correct physical preparation and ready-state cue.
facts.expected_value: Plug in the projector, open the A/V Mute slide fully, press Power, and wait for the Status light to flash blue and then remain on.

facts.description: The room access-point workflow uses Advanced rather than Quick connection mode.
facts.expected_value: Use Advanced Connection Mode because the projector and laptop connect through the room router or access point.

facts.description: The projector wireless settings are enabled, configured, and saved.
facts.expected_value: Menu > Network > Wireless LAN On > Network Configuration > Wireless LAN; select Advanced, enter the necessary network settings, and choose Complete to save and exit.

facts.description: The setup uses administrator-provided access-point information rather than invented credentials.
facts.expected_value: Obtain the room access point SSID and security settings from the network administrator and use them for projector setup.

facts.description: The presentation laptop is prepared for the same network workflow.
facts.expected_value: Install or start Epson iProjection on the Windows 10 laptop and connect the laptop to the same room network as the projector.

facts.description: The projector is switched to the LAN standby screen before software connection.
facts.expected_value: Press LAN or Source Search to switch the input to LAN and display the LAN standby screen.

facts.description: The normal software flow selects the correct mode, finds the projector, and joins it.
facts.expected_value: Start Epson iProjection, choose Advanced Connection Mode, use Automatic search, select the intended projector from the Projector List, and click Join.

facts.description: Keyword verification is handled only when the projector requests it.
facts.expected_value: If the keyword entry screen appears, enter the Projector Keyword displayed on the projection screen and confirm.

facts.description: The image gives a visible success cue for the joined session.
facts.expected_value: The computer screen is projected and the Epson iProjection toolbar appears; the input may switch to LAN automatically.

facts.description: The session is ended through the software before the projector is shut down.
facts.expected_value: Use Leave to disconnect the laptop, then press the projector Power button twice to shut it down.

facts.description: Connection paths that do not match the assigned room-network workflow are not promoted as numbered steps.
facts.expected_value: Do not use Quick direct connection, HDMI, VGA, USB Display, wired LAN, mobile QR-code projection, MHL, or a Quick Wireless Connection USB key as required main steps.

facts.description: Troubleshooting and optional collaboration features remain outside the normal workflow.
facts.expected_value: Do not make troubleshooting, moderator mode, participant controls, mirroring, multi-projector projection, thumbnail selection, bandwidth control, shortcut creation, or USB-key creation part of the numbered procedure.

facts.description: Critical dependencies and the end-of-session order are preserved.
facts.expected_value: Complete one-time projector and laptop preparation before the recurring session; display LAN standby before joining; join before projection; use Leave before pressing Power twice. Projector-network setup and laptop-software preparation may swap within the first-time section.

synthesis_notes: The eight main steps should merge closely related substeps without changing their dependency order. The documents intentionally include several other valid connection methods and advanced features; they are natural distractors for this specific room-Wi-Fi task.
